concept.label: Methane tetrahedron
concept.anchor: to hydrogen atoms arranged at the vertices of a regular tetrahedron
concept.context: CH4: central carbon, four H at 109.5 degrees.

spec.title: Methane (CH4)
spec.caption: sp3 carbon with four C–H bonds at 109.5 degrees — symmetric, so the molecule is non-polar.

concept.label: Bent water molecule
concept.anchor: to two hydrogen atoms with an H–O–H bond angle of about 104.5 degrees
concept.context: H2O bent geometry, 104.5 degrees due to two lone pairs.

spec.title: Water: a squeezed tetrahedron
spec.caption: Two bonding pairs and two lone pairs; lone-pair repulsion closes the H–O–H angle to 104.5 degrees.

concept.label: Benzene ring
concept.anchor: Benzene and Aromaticity Benzene (C6H6) is a planar six-membered ring
concept.context: C6H6 planar ring with delocalised pi electrons.

spec.title: Benzene (C6H6)
spec.caption: Six equivalent C–C bonds (139 pm) and a delocalised pi cloud above and below the ring.

concept.label: Hückel's rule
concept.anchor: monocyclic system is aromatic if it contains 4n+2 pi electrons
concept.context: Aromatic if planar, cyclic, fully conjugated with 4n+2 pi electrons.
